title: The judge court has recovered the debt for utility bills from rapper Timati
text:
The judge court restored from Rapper Timur Yunusov, known as Timati, a debt of utility bills. RIA Novosti has been reported in the Court.
The more satisfied, the court said.
Timati statements have been submitted by the Capital Fund for apartment buildings in Moscow City. The amount of debt is not specified.
“There is no payment for me”: Timati commented on a common scandal with his participation.
In 2024, the inherent repair fund was applied to musicians with court complaints. The court then issued ruling on the cancellation of orders for debt collection.
On April 28, in Moscow, the Court collected debt on utility bills from singers and composer Zhanna Aguzarova. The plaintiff is also made by the capital repair fund for apartment buildings in Moscow city.
On April 21, the brother of Russian People's Artist Alexander Domogarov was tried for debts for housing and community services. The debt amount of Andrrei Domogarov and its period were not disclosed.
Earlier in Timati, they sued 7 million rubles.
